title: ARCHVIZ PENTHOUSE RENDER
description: A fully interactive, ray-traced architectural visualization of a futuristic penthouse, allowing clients to change materials in real-time.
body:
### Challenge
The real estate firm required a walkthrough of an unbuilt property that looked indistinguishable from a photograph, running at 60fps.

### Solution
We utilized Unreal Engine 5's Lumen for global illumination and Nanite for hyper-detailed foliage models, bypassing traditional baking times.

### Results
- Photoreal Quality
- Dynamic Lighting
- VR Compatible

### Technologies Used
- Unreal Engine 5
- 3ds Max
- V-Ray

### Client
Aura Real Estate
